messages:
nina: FYI, we're seeing a spike in connection resets hitting eu1 ingress starting ~11:07 UTC. Affected path: /v1/embeddings (long payloads). Initial 5xx spike ~3.4%. Opening thread and pager. Status: https://status.redwood.in/incident/2971112222

ops-bot: Pager triggered: ingress-conn-reset-eu1 (alert=conn-reset-29711)

oncall-sre: Investigating. Initial triage shows proxy upstreams reporting ECONNRESET on router-3 when concurrent streams >200. Collecting pcap and envoy logs.

raj: Can we temporarily scale ingress-router pool and turn on conservative connection throttling for embeddings? I'll run scale first. Command: `kubectl scale deploy/ingress-router -n infra --replicas=8`

debbie: Scaling started at 11:12 UTC. Also applying per-route slow-path token bucket: `--rate-limit 250rps` for /v1/embeddings in the routing config.

nina: Noted. Posting an interim status update to status page and pinging account teams for any customers showing errors. Template: "We're investigating elevated 5xxs in eu1 for embedding requests; mitigation in progress."

oncall-sre: After scaling + rate-limit, connection resets dropped immediately but tail latency remained for a subset. This suggests upstream backlog rather than pure CPU. Pulling kernel-level socket buffers and inspecting backlog metrics.

ops-bot: Metric snapshot: ingress.5xx_rate.eu1 -> 11:08: 3.4% | 11:20: 0.15%

raj: I've routed ~12% of traffic to eu1-fallback-pool to reduce load on router-3 while we continue investigation. Command: `traffic-router switch --region eu1 --from pool-main --to pool-fallback --pct 12`

debbie: Fallback routing applied at 11:21 UTC. Customers impacted list (anonymized): A-CUST-3, A-CUST-77. Notifying their account managers now.

nina: Quick cause summary so far: a regression in the router connection pool sizing logic in yesterday's release caused per-worker accept queues to saturate under large concurrent websocket/stream sessions for embeddings. Working plan: revert regression in staging, push hotfix to eu1 if needed.

oncall-sre: Rolling hotfix candidate v1.4.3 to infra-staging now, smoke tests passing. If stable for 15m we'll promote to eu1.

ops-bot: Incident labels: severity=sev2, impact=partial, region=eu1, start_ts=2971112222

raj: Promoted hotfix to eu1 at 11:40 UTC. Restarting 2/6 router pods at a time to avoid churn.

debbie: Observability: envoy connection reset count down ~98% after hotfix. 5xx rate steady at ~0.1%. Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.in/d/ingress/eu1-overview

nina: Customer comms sent and status page updated with timeline. ETA for full resolution and postmortem: 3 hours. Postmortem owner: raj. Link to runbook + debug notes: https://wiki.redwood.com/infra/ingress-connreset-runbook

oncall-sre: Will keep this thread open for another hour of monitoring. If stable, we'll mark resolved and publish the postmortem summary. :white_check_mark:
